descriptions.preferred: 由流泉的实生苗选育而来，从叶型上来看，比较像是黄叶品种枫（金贵）和流泉的杂交品种，完美的继承了黄叶的特性和流泉枝垂的特性，春叶为橙黄色，色彩亮丽，夏季一定程度返绿，为黄绿色，但是新稍为橙黄色，秋天变为橙色或者红色，成长强健，抗性佳， 夏季午后需要适当遮阴 ，成年株可到2.5米左右高度。 黄金瀑布瀑布属于 枝 垂 系列 ，此系列有以下品种点击查看

rhs.description: A hardy, deciduous tree with a weeping habit to around 3m in height. Deeply lobed foliage is golden-yellow, turning to oranges and reds in the autumn. A seedling from 'Ryusei'

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 由流泉的实生苗选育而来，从叶型上来看，比较像是黄叶品种枫（金贵）和流泉的杂交品种，完美的继承了黄叶的特性和流泉枝垂的特性，春叶为橙黄色，色彩亮丽，夏季一定程度返绿，为黄绿色，但是新稍为橙黄色，秋天变为橙色或者红色，成长强健，抗性佳， 夏季午后需要适当遮阴 ，成年株可到2.5米左右高度。 黄金瀑布瀑布属于 枝 垂 系列 ，此系列有以下品种点击查看

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 耐寒落叶小乔木，具垂枝习性，高约 3 米。叶片深裂，呈金黄色，秋季转为橙色和红色。为 'Ryusei' 的实生苗后代。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Golden Falls' Weeping Golden Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Golden Falls' Rare Golden Weeping Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Golden Falls' is a brand new weeping selection of Japanese maple that has golden yellow foliage. This selection was found as a chance seedling from 'Ryusei'. Like its parent, it has a heavily weeping habit that will reach the height you stake it to, then cascade from that point. 'Golden Falls' will crawl across the ground creating a unique ground cover without being staked. The tree pictured is a 7 gallon, to show the shape and color of this unique tree. Give 'Golden Falls' morning sun with protection from the hot afternoon sun. Fall colors on 'Golden Falls' may be orange to red.
